name: Glassmorphism
description: Frosted glass effect with blur and transparency
implementation: backdrop-filter: blur(12px); background: rgba(255 255 255 / 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(255 255 255 / 0.2)
use_cases: SaaS dark dashboards fintech crypto apps
do_examples: Cards on dark gradient backgrounds subtle blur depth
dont_examples: Glassmorphism on white backgrounds loses all effect

name: Neumorphism
description: Soft extruded UI elements from background
use_cases: Wellness apps minimal dashboards settings UIs
dont_examples: High contrast colors dark backgrounds complex content

name: Flat Design
description: No depth or shadow pure color and shape
implementation: No box-shadow no gradients solid fills geometric shapes
use_cases: Apps requiring fast loading minimal distraction
do_examples: Clean icon sets clear hierarchy consistent color system
dont_examples: Adding slight shadows defeats the purpose

name: Material Design
description: Google's shadow and depth system with motion
implementation: box-shadow layered by elevation transition on state change
do_examples: Consistent 8px grid elevation system ripple effects
dont_examples: Overdoing shadows makes UI feel heavy and dated

name: Brutalism
implementation: Heavy borders hard shadows strong typography serif fonts
use_cases: Creative portfolios fashion brands that want to stand out
do_examples: Black borders 4px+ solid color backgrounds offset shadows
dont_examples: Brutalism applied to healthcare or finance loses trust

name: Minimalism
implementation: Large whitespace margin padding generous spacing
use_cases: Luxury brands portfolios premium SaaS editorial sites
do_examples: One CTA per screen generous line-height focused hierarchy
dont_examples: Minimalism ≠ boring — still needs strong typography

name: Dark Mode
description: Dark backgrounds for low-light comfortable use
implementation: background: #0F172A or #09090B color: #F8FAFC use CSS variables
use_cases: Dev tools crypto gaming fintech productivity apps
do_examples: True dark not gray background proper contrast ratios
dont_examples: Dark gray text on dark gray background fails WCAG

name: Gradient Mesh
implementation: CSS mesh-gradient or SVG blob shapes multiple color stops
use_cases: Startups SaaS landing pages creative agencies
do_examples: Subtle color shifts complementary palette smooth blending
dont_examples: Loud clashing gradients text over busy gradient areas

name: Bento Grid
description: Modular card grid inspired by Japanese bento boxes
implementation: CSS grid with varied column spans asymmetric layout
use_cases: SaaS feature showcases product landing pages portfolios
do_examples: Mix card sizes use whitespace as a design element
dont_examples: Making all cards same size loses the visual rhythm

name: Editorial
implementation: Strong typographic hierarchy pull quotes varied column widths
use_cases: Media news blogs newsletters high-content sites
do_examples: Mix type sizes use pull quotes break grid intentionally
dont_examples: Editorial style with weak typography misses the point

name: Skeuomorphism
implementation: Textures gradients shadows that mimic leather paper metal
use_cases: Niche apps where physicality adds value retro branding
do_examples: Use sparingly for specific interactive elements only

name: Aurora/Glow
implementation: Radial gradients with low opacity animated blur layers
use_cases: Crypto AI tools gaming dark-mode landing pages
do_examples: Soft color transitions match glow color to brand palette
dont_examples: Glows so bright they make text unreadable
